name: JournalSpeak / The Cure for Chronic Pain (Nicole Sachs)
founders: Nicole J. Sachs, LCSW (psychotherapist; former patient, later colleague, of John Sarno)
Lisa Eisenpresser (Sachs's partner; co-founder of Your BreakAwake, podcast producer)
Christina Sarno (co-creator of Sarno x Sachs practitioner training)
founded_year_range: 2013-2018. Clinical TMS practice c.2005 (site says 20+ years). Memoir The Meaning of Truth self-published 2013. YouTube channel and Freedom from Chronic Pain course existed before Oct 2018. Podcast launched 18 Oct 2018 (RSS).
cost_summary: Free podcast, YouTube and JournalSpeak 3-step guide. Prices verified Oct 2026: courses Freedom from Chronic Pain and Freedom from an Anxious Life $349 each (14 lessons, 1-year access); BreakAwake membership $9.99/mo or $99/yr; Heal with Nicole membership $99/mo or $999/yr; coaching $160/session or $640 for a 4-pack. Practitioner training (Sarno x Sachs Solution) $595, or $695 with 18.75 CE credits. Mind Your Body book (2025) sells at standard retail price. Retreats priced separately.
mechanisms: autonomic/nervous system dysregulation (sympathetic overdrive, "stuck in fight-or-flight")
neuroplastic/learned pain (brain-generated danger signal / predictive processing)
mechanism_summary: Sarno's TMS model updated with nervous-system language. Real physical symptoms are produced by the brain as a protective distraction from repressed emotions, rage and trauma. These come from childhood, present stressors and personality traits (perfectionism, "goodism"). The nervous system is held in chronic fight-or-flight and learned pain pathways; chronic pain is "an epidemic of fear." Symptoms can migrate or switch to anxiety (the "symptom imperative"). The same mechanism is applied to all conditions.
techniques: JournalSpeak: daily uncensored expressive writing (about 20 min) on past, present and personality stressors, then destroying the pages
resuming activity without fear; discontinuing PT/chiropractic
mainstream_notes: No health-system, guideline or insurer adoption. Influence runs through the TMS/mindbody physician network: John Stracks MD wrote the book's foreword and is a long-time referrer; Howard Schubiner MD and David Clarke MD have been podcast guests. There is also a practitioner training ('Sarno x Sachs Solution', 18.75 CE co-sponsored by Amedco, a jointly accredited provider approved by APA and ASWB ACE) and cross-promotion with the Curable app. The book is published by Avery (Penguin Random House), 2025.
insurance_notes: All offerings are self-pay. Coaching is by in-house certified recovered-patient coaches with no stated licensure, so it is not billable psychotherapy. Sachs no longer offers 1:1 sessions.

key_trials.citation: No trials of JournalSpeak or the Sachs program (PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov: 0 hits, verified Oct 2026)
key_trials.finding: Efficacy claims rest on testimonials and podcast recovery stories.

key_trials.citation: Frattaroli J. Experimental disclosure and its moderators: a meta-analysis. Psychol Bull 2006;132(6):823-865 (generic expressive writing, not JournalSpeak)
key_trials.finding: Small average benefit of written emotional disclosure on health and psychological outcomes. Protocols are brief (3-4 sessions), unlike open-ended daily JournalSpeak.

key_trials.citation: Broderick JE, Junghaenel DU, Schwartz JE. Written emotional expression produces health benefits in fibromyalgia patients. Psychosom Med 2005;67(2):326-34 (generic expressive writing, not JournalSpeak)
key_trials.design: RCT: trauma writing vs control writing vs usual care; 3 x 20-min sessions
key_trials.finding: Pain (ES 0.49) and fatigue (ES 0.62) reduced at 4 months vs controls; benefits not maintained at 10 months.

controversy: Claims of cures ("live entirely free of chronic conditions") extend to autoimmune disease, long COVID, ME/CFS and tinnitus, with no outcome data. Following Sarno, PT and chiropractic are discouraged. Flares are framed as proof the work is working and non-response is attributed to resistance; this makes the claims unfalsifiable and risks self-blame or missed organic disease. The free podcast funnels listeners to paid tiers and carries sponsor reads (Curable). Coaches are certified in-house, and their licensure is not stated.

popularity.reach_estimate: ~100k-500k people. Basis: 5.5M downloads spread over a few hundred episodes suggests tens of thousands of regular listeners, plus book sales (major-publisher release), YouTube and Facebook groups. Self-reported reach is inconsistent ('thousands' vs 'hundreds of thousands'). Paid course and membership users are likely in the low tens of thousands.
popularity.method_notes: Anchored on dated indicators: memoir 2013; course and YouTube before 2018; podcast launch Oct 2018; RSS episode counts per year; 2M downloads Oct 2021 and 5.5M by 2026; book Feb 2025; membership, coaching and practitioner-training expansion 2024-26. Instagram (~187K) and YouTube (~31.2K) counts checked Oct 2026. Google Trends was not compiled and Reddit blocked automated access, so trajectory values are judgement-based.
